* Experience writing and maintaining automated test scripts using tools like Cypress, Playwright or Selenium IDE
* Proficiency in API testing tools (e.g. Postman)
* Strong experience in AI LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude to support your day to day role
* Hands-on experience with Flutter test automation
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g. Azure DevOps)
* Some experience with programming languages such as C#, Dart, JavaScript and Python
* Solid knowledge of testing principles, defect tracking, and test case management
* Experience in accessibility and performance testing
* Experience of cloud platforms (e.g. Azure)
* Experience testing mobile applications (iOS/Android)
* Good understanding of agile methodologies and working in digital product squads
* Good knowledge of the full software delivery life cycle, working closely with engineers to drive efficiencies
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

It's not essential, but we'd love to hear if you have the following:

* Understanding of cost management principles when working with cloud services
* Experience working with logging and monitoring tools to ensure reliability of services within a distributed system
* ISTQB, CPTA or equivalent qualification

About Greggs

Here at Greggs, we love what we do, and we have fun! What makes us so special is our culture - how we behave and support each other. Everyone's welcome at Greggs. Whatever their background, preferences or beliefs we want all of our colleagues to feel welcome and able to be themselves at work. You can read more about us here: Greggs Careers | About Greggs.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Developers
jobs.description:
**Location:** Edinburgh and Bristol  
**Salary:** £36,000 per annum

*We maintain a flexible working policy to allow for hybrid working when appropriate. Teams typically spend around 60% of their time in the office, although this may vary depending on project and business needs.*

If you are an engineering graduate who has recently graduated, or is due to graduate next year, we would love to hear from you. We have exciting opportunities for 5 Software Developer graduates to launch their career within a world-leading technology company developing advanced software solutions for uncrewed maritime systems. You can be based in either our Edinburgh or Bristol office.

Working as part of a collaborative engineering project team, you will contribute to the design, development, testing and integration of innovative software solutions that are deployed by customers across the globe. You will be supported through structured development, training and mentoring to help you grow into a highly capable software engineering professional.

**Why Join SeeByte?**

This is a unique opportunity to join a world-respected company operating at the forefront of autonomous and robotic technologies. You will work alongside experienced engineers, researchers and technical specialists while contributing to software solutions that solve complex real-world challenges.

SeeByte offers an environment where you can develop your technical expertise, build meaningful industry experience and benefit from clear career progression opportunities within a supportive and innovative culture.

For more information about life at SeeByte, our employee benefits, culture and recruitment process, please visit our Career Site

**Main Purpose of the Role**

As a Graduate Software Developer, you will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, helping to transform customer requirements into high-quality solutions while developing your technical expertise and gaining experience across a range of technologies and projects. Substantial support, training and development will be provided to enable you to grow within the role and build a successful career in software engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, test and deliver robust C# software solutions.
* Contribute to software design, development, testing and integration activities across engineering projects.
* Deliver work to a high standard while proactively identifying opportunities for software improvement.
* Work with colleagues to understand, analyse and break down customer and project requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with engineers, technical specialists and external stakeholders.
* Participate in code reviews, testing activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop knowledge of modern software engineering practices, tools and technologies.

**Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or working towards gaining a degree in a relevant discipline in 2027.
* Ideally a focus on developing software using C# gained through academic, personal or commercial projects, though a background in other programming languages would also be suitable (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript)
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team.
* Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and developing technical skills.
* Eligible to apply for UK Security Clearance.

**Desirable:**

* Knowledge of modern C# language features.
* Experience of XAML-based Windows UI development, ideally WPF.
* Understanding of software verification and deployment techniques.
* Familiarity with defect tracking and collaboration tools such as GitLab or Jira.
* Knowledge of Continuous Delivery frameworks such as Jenkins.

**You Will Stand Out If You:**

* **Deliver Results**: Are focused on delivering excellent outcomes for customers.
* **Collaborate**: Communicate clearly, respectfully and effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Actively contribute to a positive, collaborative and inclusive team culture.
* Enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* **Adaptive Thinking**: Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and a genuine passion for learning.
* Take ownership of your development and seek opportunities to expand your skills and experience.

At SeeByte, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and supporting employee wellbeing. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to people@seebyte.com

**Because of the nature of the work associated with this post it is subject to special nationality rules and is open only to the following nationalities since birth: British, EE, Switzerland, Iceland Norway, Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Japan. Due to government security restrictions dual nationality can only be considered within this list of countries**

**All offers of employment will be conditional upon successful completion of a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) process and may require security clearance depending on project requirements.**

**As part of this process, SeeByte collects personal data as defined under UK GDPR, including proof of identity, nationality and immigration status, right to work in the UK, employment and/or academic references, and Basic Disclosure information relating to unspent criminal convictions. Please refer to our Privacy Notice for further information.**

**No recruitment agencies.**

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At AtkinsRéalis Nuclear, we're using digital technology to help solve complex engineering challenges and create safer, more efficient and better-connected ways of working.

We're looking for a Junior Full Stack Engineer to join our multidisciplinary digital team, developing secure, user-focused software for engineering and operational environments. You'll contribute across front-end, back-end and cloud technologies, working alongside experienced colleagues who will support you as your skills and confidence grow.

Our digital teams create products and services that connect people, data and physical assets. This includes web platforms, cloud services and data-driven applications used across complex engineering environments.

You'll contribute to both live products and new ideas, helping turn user needs into reliable and maintainable software. You'll have opportunities to learn from others, share your ideas and gradually take greater ownership as you develop.

We value curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to learn as much as technical knowledge. You don't need to know every technology we use from day one. We're looking for someone with good software development foundations who is excited to keep learning and growing with us.

**Your role**
-------------

As a Junior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work collaboratively with product managers, designers, engineers and subject-matter experts to understand challenges and turn ideas into practical digital solutions.

You'll:

* Develop and improve web applications, contributing to user-facing features using technologies such as JavaScript and Vue.js.
* Build and support back-end services and APIs, working with technologies including JavaScript, Python and .NET.
* Contribute to cloud-based solutions, developing your experience with platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services.
* Work closely with colleagues and users to understand their needs, explore possible solutions and translate requirements into working software.
* Create clear, maintainable and testable code, learning and applying good engineering standards and modern development practices.
* Help improve our applications by investigating issues, resolving defects and contributing ideas that enhance performance, reliability, security and user experience.
* Collaborate and share your thinking, taking part in code reviews, technical discussions, demonstrations and team planning while communicating progress, challenges and what you've learned.
* You'll have support from experienced colleagues while being encouraged to take increasing ownership of your work. Sometimes you'll work from clear requirements, while at other times you'll have the opportunity to ask questions, explore a problem and work with others to find the right approach.

**About you**
-------------

We're interested in your strengths, potential and approach to learning, rather than expecting you to have experience with every technology our teams use.

You may enjoy this opportunity if you:

* Have developed a foundation in software engineering or computer science through a degree, relevant training, professional experience or another learning pathway.
* Have practical experience with JavaScript and Python, and some exposure to developing web applications, back-end services or APIs.
* Have experience with, or an interest in developing your knowledge of, technologies such as Vue.js, .NET and cloud platforms.
* Enjoy solving problems and learning from others, and are comfortable asking questions or seeking support when you need it.
* Have an understanding of areas such as APIs, web application architecture, source control and modern software development practices.
* Enjoy working collaboratively and can communicate your ideas, progress and challenges clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* We'd'also welcome experience or an interest in areas such as TypeScript, Node.js, databases, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code, cloud monitoring or secure software development. These are helpful, but we don't'expect you to bring all of them.
* Experience in engineering, infrastructure, nuclear, high-hazard or other safety-critical environments can be useful, but it isn't'essential. We're equally interested in what you've learned through personal, academic or professional software projects and the contribution you made.
* Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is curious, collaborative and motivated to develop, with the foundations to grow as a software engineer and contribute to technology that makes a meaningful difference.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Rewards and benefits – Careers at AtkinsRéalis

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

**Additional information**
--------------------------

**Security clearance**

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability. As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to offering an interview to all applicants who have a disability and meet the essential criteria. If you would like to be considered under this commitment, please let us know at the application stage.

jobs.title: Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our innovative team as a Web Developer Intern and dive into the dynamic world of web application development! This paid internship offers an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in building responsive, user-friendly websites and web services. You'll collaborate with seasoned developers to enhance your skills in front-end and back-end technologies, contributing to real projects that make a difference. If you're passionate about coding, eager to learn, and ready to develop your career in software development, this is the perfect role for you!

**Duties**

* Assist in designing and developing engaging, responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Support back-end development tasks with technologies such as Node.js, Django, ASP.NET Core, or Ruby on Rails to create robust web services and APIs.
* Collaborate on database management and integration using MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQL Server to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
* Contribute to version control workflows utilizing GitHub, Git, SVN, or Jenkins for seamless code management and deployment.
* Participate in wireframing and UX/UI design processes to craft intuitive user experiences that align with project goals.
* Assist in testing applications through unit testing and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables.
* Support DevOps practices by working with Docker containers, AWS cloud services, Ansible automation tools, and continuous integration pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Web Development or a related field.
* Demonstrated knowledge of front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3 (SCSS/SASS), JavaScript (TypeScript), AJAX, Bootstrap, and responsive web design principles.
* Familiarity with back-end frameworks such as Node.js, Django,.NET (C#), or PHP for server-side development.
* Experience with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or SQL Server; understanding of SQL queries and data visualization techniques.
* Knowledge of version control systems including Git or SVN; experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins is a plus.
* Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and web services; exposure to GraphQL or SOAP is advantageous.
* Ability to work collaboratively within Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban using tools like Jira or Trello.
* Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail; eager to learn new technologies like AWS cloud platform or DevOps practices.

Embark on this journey with us and develop your skills while contributing to impactful web projects! This internship not only enhances your technical expertise but also immerses you in a vibrant team environment dedicated to innovation and growth.

Pay: £5.00-£10.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**At the heart of everything we do is our vision to change lives every day, and our mission to grow The National Lottery responsibly and champion its impact.**

We are Allwyn UK, part of the Allwyn Entertainment Group – a multi-national lottery operator with a market-leading presence across Europe which includes: Czech Republic, Austria, Greece, Cyprus & Italy, and the US.

While the main contribution of The National Lottery to society is through the funds to good causes, at Allwyn we put our purpose and values at the heart of everything we do. Join us as we embark on a once-in-a-lifetime, largescale transformation journey by creating a National Lottery that delivers more money to good causes.

We’ll talk a bit more about us further down the page, but for now – let’s talk about the role and who we’re looking for…

If you need any assistance or adjustments to this job description or in the application process, please contact a member of the talent team at careers@allwyn.co.uk and we’ll be happy to help.

**A bit about the role**

As Allwyn transitions most of its technology services from on premise into a multi-cloud environment, Cloud Security becomes critically important to ensure our core services and gaming platforms are safe.

The DevOps engineer is the dedicated DevOps specialist focused on prioritising and resolving security defects and vulnerabilities across cloud platforms and application pipelines.

The role acts as the technical bridge between Cloud Engineering and the Security Operation Centre (SOC), Enterprise Security and Cyber Defence teams. The DevOps Engineer ensures that cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines in AWS and Azure are Secure by Design, automating remediation where possible and embedding security controls into infrastructure as code (IaC) and CI/CD pipelines. You will champion secure engineering practices ensuring both speed of delivery and robust security posture across all environments

**What you’ll be doing**

* Monitor, triage and remediate vulnerabilities across applications, cloud workloads, containers, CI/CD pipelines and IaC repositories
* Work closely with SOC, Enterprise Security and Cyber Defence teams to respond to active and emerging threats ensuring rapid technical remediation
* Integrate security tooling into CI/CD pipelines including container scanning and secret scanning
* Maintain and improve IaC security posture using Terraform and ensure compliance with security baselines and guardrails
* Automate security checks and enforcement using policy as code, security scanners and cloud native services
* Support threat modelling and secure solution design with engineering teams
* Own vulnerability management workflows and ensure timely remediation in line with risk and audit expectations
* Implement and maintain cloud security configurations (IAM, key management, WAF security groups, logging and monitoring)
* Produce technical documentation, runbooks and remediation guidance for engineering teams
* Work with product and engineering teams to embed security into development standards
* Create and enforce governance policies

**What experience we’re looking for**

* 3-5+ years hands-on experience in DevOps, platform engineering or DevSecOps role
* Strong development background with the ability to build automation and tooling for security remediation
* Strong infrastructure as code experience using Terraform across AWS and Azure
* Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access controls, network security and container security in AWS and Azure
* Experience integrating and managing security controls
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines including GitHub Actions
* Practical experience with vulnerability management, threat remediation and working with the Security Operating Centre and Cyber teams
* Strong understanding of modern application architectures
* Demonstrated ability to keep up with rapidly evolving cloud technologies

**Key Measures of Success:**

* Reduction in critical and high-risk vulnerabilities within agreed SLAs, cloud and application environments
* Improved security posture as measured by cloud security benchmarks, IaC scanning results and automated policy compliance
* Effective collaboration and faster incident response with SOC, Enterprise Security and Cyber Defence teams
* Automation coverage increased, reducing manual remediation effort and improving consistency
* Secure pipelines, evidence by adoption of scanning tools and zero high or critical findings reaching production
* Positive feedback from engineering teams regarding clarity, support and quality of security guidance
* Audit and compliance targets met with no major findings related to DevOps or Cloud security practices

**About us**

At Allwyn, we are dedicated to changing lives and growing the National Lottery responsibly, championing its positive impact on people, places, and the planet.

* **Innovation -** We pride ourselves on it! We’re constantly looking for new ways to excite our customers, bringing new products to market to enjoy which is all supported by our responsible play values and making them accessible to all.
* **Giving back –** Did you know that playing the lottery generates around £30m a week for charities and good causes in the UK? Our aim is to have doubled this number by the end of the first 10-year license
* **Sustainability –** Our aim is to become a net zero national lottery. We have 2030 targets to decarbonise our operations and energy. We’ve already transitioned to renewable energy providers, made our London and Watford offices zero gas, and ensured our fleet consists of low-emission vehicles. In addition, we’re working with our value chain partners to develop a net zero target date.
* **Empowering every voice** – We believe in creating a culture where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, has access to opportunities and can thrive for the benefit of good causes. Our diverse teams are working hard to make all parts of The National Lottery inclusive – whether people play a game in a store or online- - because when everyone can play, everyone wins.

Our people are more than colleagues - they’re winners, driving positive change and making a real difference in communities.

We are a Disability Confident Leader which means we’ve taken proactive steps to ensure our workplace is accessible and inclusive for disabled and neurodivergent colleagues and candidates. As part of this we offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the essential requirements of the job.

**An inclusive reward offering with wellbeing at the centre**

At Allwyn, inclusion is built into how we care for our people. Our benefits and policies support colleagues—and their families—at every stage of life and career. By prioritising wellbeing and belonging, we create a workplace where everyone feels valued, rewarded, and empowered to succeed.

**BENEFITS**

Our benefits are built to support you at every stage of life. From wellbeing and financial security to enjoying more of what you love, our benefit offerings help you thrive at work and at home.

* Company Bonus Scheme
* Matched pension contributions up to 8.5%
* 26 days annual leave + 2 Life Days (and bank holidays)
* Single Private Health Cover
* Complimentary Private Medical
* Income Protection
* Flexible Benefits – EV Scheme, Money Coach, Will Writing, Mortgage Advice, Dental and Eye Care Schemes.
* Enhanced Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity, Adoption)
* Wellness Allowance £500
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Discounted Health Assessments
* Volunteering Days
* Matched Funding

* Building and supporting real-time data processing systems for P&L and risk analytics
* Working on out-of-process services, system integrations, and data materialisation layers
* Driving Agile best practices, including test-driven development (TDD) and automation
* Collaborating with global teams across EMEA, NY, and APAC
* Taking ownership of features and proactively proposing improvements
* Troubleshooting issues and helping unblock cross-team dependencies

Essential Skills & Experience

* Strong expertise in C# / .NET development
* Experience with Redis Cluster

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies

* End-to-end experience across the full software development lifecycle

jobs.title: ERP Systems Developer & Support
jobs.description:
Established in 1986, OE Electrics designs and manufactures innovative power solutions from its headquarters in Wakefield, West Yorkshire.

We are looking for an **ERP Systems Developer & Support** professional to join our Transformation Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in developing, supporting, and enhancing business-critical systems that drive efficiency and support growth across the organisation.

**The Role**

Working closely with the ERP Systems Manager, you will help develop and maintain software solutions that improve business processes and maximise the effectiveness of our ERP systems.

This role offers the opportunity to build expertise in ERP systems, SAP Business One, manufacturing processes, SQL Server development, software integrations, and solution design while working closely with experienced technical and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Development & Support: Assist in developing, testing, and deploying software enhancements and integrations based on design specifications.
* System Maintenance: Support and maintain ERP-related applications and databases to ensure business-critical systems remain robust and operational.
* Technical Problem Solving: Investigate and resolve user support queries, providing technical support to users and escalating complex issues when necessary.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with colleagues across finance, sales, manufacturing, and supply chain to understand operational needs and deliver practical technical solutions.
* Documentation & Quality: Follow established development standards and maintain clear documentation to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

**Essential Skills**

* Commercial Experience: Commercial software development experience, relevant apprenticeship experience, or equivalent practical experience.
* Core Technologies: Practical exposure to C#, Microsoft .NET, and Microsoft SQL.
* Problem-Solving Mindset: An inquisitive, analytical nature with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical business colleagues.
* Organization: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple support and development tasks effectively.

**Desirable**

* Experience with SAP Business One or the SAP SDK.
* Background or interest in a manufacturing environment.
* Prior technical support or helpdesk experience.

**About Our Systems Environment**

* Finance, purchasing and stock management

* CRM and sales order processing
* Manufacturing Execution System

jobs.title: Trainee Project Engineer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Trainee Project Engineer to join our Survey and Robotics team in Westhill. This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their career who is looking for engaging, hands-on experience working on software development, automation tools, AI-driven solutions and workshop improvement projects. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and operational teams to develop technical, problem-solving, and project delivery skills through involvement in the design, build, testing, and deployment of both digital and physical solutions that enhance workshop and business processes.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The GM Risk and Capital Optimization Technology team is seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Senior DevOps Engineer** to join the TAROT platform team based in London.

This is a key technical role responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting the DevOps capabilities that underpin a suite of strategic risk and capital optimization solutions. The successful candidate will drive automation, improve software delivery processes, enhance operational resilience, and ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of the platform.

Working closely with software engineers, architects, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders, the Senior DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in modernizing development and deployment practices, streamlining release management, and supporting mission-critical applications within a highly regulated financial services environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **DevOps Engineering & Automation**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade DevOps frameworks and best practices.
* Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, test, deployment, and release processes.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first approaches across application and platform environments.
* Automate operational processes, environment provisioning, and deployment activities to improve efficiency and reduce risk.
* Continuously improve software delivery lifecycle processes, deployment frequency, and release quality.

### **Source Control & Release Management**

* Manage and administer source code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
* Support application versioning, release governance, and deployment planning across multiple environments.
* Implement best practices for code promotion, artifact management, and release automation.
* Collaborate with development teams to ensure consistent development standards and deployment practices.

### **Environment & Platform Management**

* Support multiple application environments including development, testing, UAT, and production.
* Manage application hosting platforms and ensure platform stability, availability, and performance.
* Monitor platform health and proactively identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.
* Support disaster recovery, resilience, and business continuity requirements.

### **Infrastructure & Operations**

* Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to ensure platforms are secure, scalable, and compliant.
* Manage Windows Server environments supporting business-critical applications.
* Administer and support IIS-hosted applications and web services.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and application performance issues across environments.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational readiness initiatives.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Embed security controls and DevSecOps principles into the software delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise technology standards, risk controls, and operational procedures.
* Support platform vulnerability remediation, patch management, and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to enhance security automation and monitoring capabilities.

### **Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with software engineering teams to improve development workflows and deployment automation.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers on DevOps best practices and operational excellence.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to platform modernization initiatives.
* Act as a subject matter expert for DevOps tooling, automation, and operational support.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

### **Experience**

* Significant experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering role.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience supporting complex, business-critical applications in production environments.
* Strong experience working within financial services, banking, capital markets, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.
  

  

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **Essential**

* Strong experience with CI/CD tools and automated deployment frameworks.
* Extensive knowledge of source control systems and repository management.
* Strong Windows Server administration experience.
* Strong Microsoft technology stack expertise.
* Hands-on experience administering and supporting IIS (Internet Information Services).
* Experience with release management, deployment automation, and software delivery lifecycle management.
* Strong troubleshooting and operational support capabilities.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance management tools.

### **Desirable**

* Python scripting and automation development.
* PowerShell scripting and Windows automation.
* Infrastructure as Code technologies.
* Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred).
* Experience with application monitoring and observability platforms.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with SonarQube, security scanning, and code quality tooling.
* Experience supporting .NET and Microsoft-based application stacks.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving technology environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Able to balance strategic initiatives with hands-on operational responsibilities.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

**About the job:**

Kent is looking for a Graduate Software Engineer to be based in Aberdeen.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?

Our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team works closely with our clients to develop high-quality software solutions that add real value to their operations. By combining high-end technical knowledge with modern software development, the team provides its clients with the tools needed to efficiently and reliably solve many of the Energy industry’s technical challenges, across a wide range of disciplines. As a graduate in our team, you will be working on intelligent and useful software to support some of the most challenging engineering projects, helping shape the future of energy. You will get involved in the full software development lifecycle, solving exciting challenges and growing into a high-quality software engineer.

**About our Graduate Scheme**

Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.

If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.

Our global graduate program offers hands-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.

**Application Process**

As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.

**Application Deadline**

All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.

**Recruitment Timeline**

Shortlisting and pre-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026.

**Eligibility**

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

**Hybrid Working**

We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.

**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**

**Skills & Responsibilities:**

As a software developer joining our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team, you will:

* Become an integral part of a growing team, collaborating with your colleagues to develop, deliver and support a variety of innovative software solutions that meet clients’ requirements within time and budget constraints.

* Get involved in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering, design and implementation, through to testing, deployment, maintenance and support. We use a lean and agile methodology, giving you the opportunity to grow into a well-rounded developer, and allowing you to have an impact on every stage of a project.

* Deliver bespoke software applications using a range of modern technologies and platforms, from desktop applications and services to web and cloud solutions and Microsoft Office automation. The team will help you continuously improve your programming skills, learn new things and keep up to date with the latest developments in the industry.

* Solve logical and algorithmic problems, review them with the wider team, and implement these solutions into working software features.

* Learn and adhere to our software engineering standards, procedures and best practices, and provide suggestions for continuous improvements.

* Build and configure test environments and carry out unit and factory acceptance tests for our developed applications.

* Produce relevant user documentation and deployment guides.

* Provide support to our clients, both external and internal, for our growing portfolio of software products.

* Help deploy software applications and systems and provide training to end users when required.

* Be part of an excellent working environment, collaborating with technical experts across various domains and disciplines to produce software of the highest quality standards.

Our technology stack is mostly Microsoft-based: we develop software using .NET and Visual Studio, primarily in C#, but also VB.NET for legacy applications. We use Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) and legacy WinForms for our desktop apps, ASP.NET and Angular for web development, SQL Server and Azure for data. We also use Python for various data analytics or scripting solutions. You will also get to develop clever macros using VBA to help our engineering teams become more efficient and save time through automation. All of these will be supported by using Artificial Intelligence, particularly Large Language Models, to increase our development efficiency, so you will be gaining more experience with using some of the latest models.

In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.

**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or similar / related field).

* Experience in software development, preferably using .NET (C# or VB.NET) or Python, gained through work experience, degree coursework or self-study. Ideally, you will have used .NET, SQL in the past and have experience with desktop and web development (preferably with some of WPF, WinForms, ASP.NET MVC and WebAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, but not essential). We will help you constantly improve your skills and become a great developer, as long as you are passionate about technology, software development, and artificial intelligence, and willing to learn and adapt to the rapid pace of the industry.

* Understanding of software development principles and strong commitment to delivering to high quality standards, constantly looking for innovation and improvements, whilst futureproofing your work

**Communication:**

* Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.

**Behaviour/ Core Competencies:**

* Technically minded with strong analytical and logical problem-solving skills. A passion for solving difficult challenges, and persistence are desirable.

* Able to work in an agile environment, adapting to various domains and coping with uncertainty and changing requirements.

* Ability to work in a team, across a variety of projects and technologies and to prioritise workload, ensuring that quality and timeliness of deliverables is met.

* Creativity and strong communication skills for both business and technical audiences.

* A practical mind and being self-motivated, hard-working and reliable.

* We are looking for candidates who are due to graduate in 2027, or have graduated in the last 2 years.

**HSSEQ:**

The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.

We are committed to our diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop. From day one, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and employee networks to support staff from different backgrounds.

As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.

We’re a disability-friendly employer and can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. Please contact us confidentially at recruitment.uk@kentplc.com to find out how we can support you.

* Rozwój komponentów systemu i tworzenie rozwiązań front-end oraz back-end
* Analiza wymagań, projektowanie i prototypowanie rozwiązań
* Testowanie oprogramowania oraz udział w QA, change management i deployment
* Optymalizacja rozwiązań pod kątem wydajności, bezpieczeństwa i jakości
* Tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej
* Zapewnianie bezpiecznego kodu po stronie .NET i JavaScript
* Wsparcie użytkowników na poziomie 2nd/3rd line
* Proponowanie rozwiązań technicznych odpowiadających na potrzeby biznesowe i problemy techniczne

* Min. 2-letnie doświadczenie zawodowe w branży IT
* Min. 1-letnie doświadczenie w podobnej roli
* Doświadczenie w realizacji pełnego cyklu życia rozwiązania
* Znajomość SharePoint Framework (SPFx), React i JavaScript
* Doświadczenie w pracy z SharePoint Data: PnP, SharePoint REST API, Microsoft Graph API

* Znajomość zasad secure coding / OWASP, w tym zabezpieczeń przed XSS i SQL Injection
* Umiejętność czytania UML
* Znajomość standardów jakości i dobrych praktyk wytwarzania oprogramowania
* Umiejętność tworzenia dokumentacji technicznej
* Wykształcenie wyższe
* Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie b2

--------------

* Długoterminowa współpraca
* Możliwość podnoszenia kwalifikacji zawodowych
* Atmosfera otwartości i współpracy w zgranym zespole

jobs.description:
**Position:**  
Technical Sales Engineer
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Technical Sales Engineer
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
This position sits within Arrow Global Components (AGC), a part of Arrow Electronics, and is responsible for building and maintaining influential relationships with customers, suppliers, and Arrow partners to create demand for Arrow products. The role combines demand creation, account management, and relationship development, with a strong focus on proactively offering engineering and supply chain solutions and matching Arrow’s solutions to customer business needs.
  
  
**WHAT WILL YOU DO:**  

* Build and maintain influential relationships with customers, suppliers, and Arrow partners to create demand for Arrow products.
* Identify technical needs of complex, emerging, or underpenetrated prospects and match Arrow’s solutions to customer business needs.
* Drive and create new opportunities and product selection within assigned accounts, using other technical resources as needed.
* Initiate and schedule regular visits to customer facilities, gain a solid understanding of customer needs, and translate those needs into Arrow requirements or business opportunities.
* Execute solution selling through a working knowledge of Arrow’s supply chain solutions and design processes, with emphasis on demand creation and engineering.
* Stay current on product knowledge and related technologies, attend supplier training events, and maintain supplier databases and design registration information accurately.

**WHO YOU ARE:**  

* Higher degree, ideally in Engineering, combined with a strong interest in technology and innovation.
* Around 5 years of experience in the electronics industry is preferred.
* Innovative and fresh approach to business development, with the ability to introduce changes and new solutions supported by business justification.
* Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills, as well as strong problem-solving, diplomacy, and influencing skills.
* Professional and proactive attitude.
* Goal-oriented mindset.
* Business fluent English is a must.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**  

* Competitive base salary with a performance-based bonus structure.
* Company car.
* Hybrid work model with flexible working hours.
* Private medical care (Medicover) and the MyBenefit platform, including Multisport.
* Career development opportunities within a global organization.
* Participation in key industry conferences and technology events.
* Supportive, international, and open corporate culture.

**WHO WE ARE:**  
AsArrow Global Components(AGC), a part of Arrow Electronics, we are a leader in distribution and value-added services related to electronic components. We resell, customize, and distribute electronic components to our clients all over the world. Our business is based on a trusted, long-lasting net of relationships with industry leaders, both on the supplier and customer side.
  
  
Arrow is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to create a diverse working environment by providing equal employment opportunity for all qualified persons.

**The opportunity**

  

Join us as a Customer Configurator (Camos) Solution Architect and help shape innovative sales and commerce solutions. You will collaborate with business and technology teams to design scalable configuration solutions using Camos within our Digital Commerce platforms. This role offers the opportunity to drive process improvements, influence our sales ecosystem, and contribute to the growth of our Center of Excellence.

  

**How you will make an impact**

jobs.title: Game Developer - Puzzle Games
jobs.description:
**About Voodoo**
================

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

**Team**
========

You will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

In this exciting role, your initial focus will be on one of our new Puzzle Games that have already demonstrated significant promise and captured our attention with their compelling core mechanics and engaging gameplay.

**Role**
========

We are looking for a senior Unity C# Game Developer who has been a primary contributor to the Game architecture, Feature development, and design for several casual games. You will collaborate with a variety of experts: Product Managers, Game Artists, Game Developers, Tech Engineers, Monetization Managers, Data Analysts...

* Work closely with small teams of Unity Game Developers and Artists
* Implement game logic and systems in C# using Unity
* Adapt and work within an existing code base, enhancing its functionality, stability and performance
* Provide guidance and share your expertise
* Ensure timely delivery of high-quality results

**Profile**
===========

* Advanced Unity knowledge (3y+) including scripting in C#, UI systems, animation, particle systems, etc.
* A critical thinker and a problem solver with a keen eye for identifying problems in workflows and processes (and driving them to a resolution)
* Previous experience and exposure to the game production process (as part of a game dev studio or otherwise)
* Skilled in identifying performance bottlenecks and implementing optimisations, with a strong focus on memory management, frame rate stability, and reducing load times
* Experience with analytics-driven development and A/B testing in live games would be a plus
* Excellent communication skills and a strong teamwork mindset
* Good sense of gameplay experience and special attention to detail
* Speak and write English

**Benefits**
============

* Competitive salary
* Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family 100% borne by Voodoo
* Swile Lunch voucher
* Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)
* Wellness activities in our Paris office
* Child daycare facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouges)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Golang, Order)
jobs.description:
**About SpotOn**

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh\*t about helping restaurants succeed.

* **Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2** (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
* Rated the **top-rated point-of-sale** (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
* Awarded **Great Places to Work** and Built In’s **Best Workplaces** for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.

**The ideal candidate will be able to:**

* **Take extreme ownership:** You don’t just close tickets; you own the outcome. If a feature breaks or a customer is stuck, you’re the one who sees the fix through, regardless of where the problem sits in the stack.
* **Navigate real complexity:** We aren’t doing simple CRUD work. You will be untangling massive systems and solving high-stakes puzzles that require creative thinking and the grit to push through frustration.
* **Be a "whatever it takes" engineer:** You are flexible. If the frontend lead is out or an infra fire starts, you’re ready to jump in, learn what you don't know, and clear the path for the team.
* **Treat AI as a teammate:** We use AI tools daily to move faster. You’ll be expected to leverage these tools to solve "impossible" problems and keep our quality bar high.
* **Drive the team forward:** You’ll provide technical leadership, ensuring we’re making smart decisions and addressing tech debt before it becomes a roadblock.

**What skill are we searching for?**

* **Real-world experience:** You’ve spent at least 5 to 7 years building software that survives high-traffic, production environments.
* **Backend mastery:** You are highly proficient in **Golang** and ideally also **PHP**.
* **AI fluency:** You have already integrated AI into your workflow and know how to use it to write better code and debug complex systems.
* **Solid fundamentals:** You have a deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns that allow you to build for scale.
* **Strong communication:** You have a solid command of English (min. B2) and are ready to collaborate in person at our Kraków or Gdańsk offices 2-3 times a week.

**Perfect candidate also has:**

* **The "Figure it Out" gene:** You actually enjoy the challenge of a problem that doesn’t have a clear answer on the first page of a search result.
* **Full-stack flexibility:** You aren’t afraid of **React** or **JavaScript** if that’s what’s needed to get a project across the finish line.
* **Cloud and Infra comfort:** You’ve spent enough time with **AWS**, **Terraform**, or **Kubernetes** to understand how your code lives in the wild.
* **A mentoring mindset:** you naturally raise the bar for those around you through thoughtful code reviews and shared knowledge.

**Here’s a bit about what we have to offer:**

* Competitive pay: **23 800 - 29 800 PLN net on B2B.**
* Training budget 3500 PLN gross per year.
* Access to e-learning platforms (O’Reilly).
* Fully paid private healthcare in LuxMed.
* Access to the Worksmile platform with a monthly top-up.
* Subsidized access to breakfast and lunch through the vending machine in Kraków office, and lunches in Gdańsk office once a week.
* Group English classes with a native speaker.
* New Macbook Pro, 4K monitors or whatever tools you need.
* Flexible working hours.
* New, modern, bright and comfortable office space in the city centre.
* Access to the company’s library.
* Great working atmosphere.
* Chill out room with a PlayStation and games.
* Free snacks and beverages in a kitchen.
* Company parties and social activities.
* Employee referral program.
* Relocation Package within Poland.

The controller of your personal data included in your job offer and others collected during the recruitment process is SpotOn Poland spółka z ograniczoną odpowiedzialnością with its registered office in Kraków, Aleja 29 listopada 20, 31-401 Kraków, e-mail address:
  
poland-rodo@spoton.com. We will process your personal data for the purpose of current or, if you voluntarily agree, also future recruitment processes. More information about how we proccess your data, including the basis for processing and your rights in relation to the processing, can be found on our website: https://pl.spoton.com/privacy-and-cookies-policy.

jobs.title: Senior Lösningsarkitekt / Solution Architect - Malmö eller Kalmar
jobs.description:
Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för lösningar där verksamhetsbehov, komplexa systemlandskap och modern Microsoft-teknik behöver fungera tillsammans?  
CGI söker en erfaren Senior Lösningsarkitekt / Solution Architect till vårt team i Malmö eller Kalmar. Vi söker dig som är trygg i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och teknik och som kan omsätta komplexa behov till hållbara lösningar – från tidig dialog och arkitektur till genomförande.  
I rollen får du arbeta med lösningar där flera system, plattformar, integrationer och dataflöden behöver samspela. Du kommer nära både kunden och våra tekniska team och får en central roll i att skapa riktning, fatta lösningsbeslut och se till att helheten håller över tid.  
Du behöver ha ett tekniskt djup och förstå hur moderna lösningar byggs, men det här är inte en roll där du förväntas detaljstyra implementationen. Din styrka ligger i att se helheten, ställa rätt frågor och samla rätt kompetenser kring rätt lösning.

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**

Som Senior Lösningsarkitekt arbetar du från verksamhetsbehov och krav till sammanhängande lösningsarkitektur.  
Du leder lösningsdiskussioner tillsammans med kund, verksamhet, utvecklingsteam, tekniska arkitekter och andra specialister. Du analyserar alternativ och beroenden och hjälper kunden att fatta välgrundade beslut utifrån verksamhetsnytta, teknik, kostnad och långsiktig förvaltning.  
Du kommer bland annat att:  

* designa och driva end-to-end-lösningar i komplexa systemlandskap
* omsätta verksamhetsbehov, processer och krav till hållbar lösningsarkitektur
* leda workshops, lösningsdiskussioner och arkitekturella vägval tillsammans med kund och tekniska team
* säkerställa att system, plattformar, integrationer och komponenter fungerar tillsammans som en helhet
* arbeta med integrationer, API, dataflöden och systemberoenden
* utvärdera lösningsalternativ och driva beslut från behov och målbild till realiserbar lösning
* vägleda och utmana utvecklare och tekniska arkitekter med stöd av din förståelse för systemutveckling, .NET och C#
* identifiera risker, beroenden och arkitekturella konsekvenser tidigt
* involvera rätt specialister och delegera tekniska frågeställningar till rätt kompetens
* kommunicera komplexa lösningar på ett begripligt sätt för både verksamhet, ledning och tekniska målgrupper.

**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**

Vem söker vi?  
Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet som Solution Architect, Lösningsarkitekt eller i en motsvarande senior arkitektroll och som har arbetat med lösningar där flera system och tekniska plattformar behöver fungera tillsammans.  
  
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:  

* senior erfarenhet av att designa och driva sammanhängande lösningar i komplexa systemlandskap
* förmåga att förstå verksamhetsprocesser och krav och omsätta dem till hållbara tekniska lösningar
* god förståelse för systemutveckling och .NET/C#, med tillräckligt tekniskt djup för att kunna utmana och vägleda utvecklingsteam och tekniska arkitekter
* erfarenhet av systemintegration, API, integrationsarkitektur och dataflöden
* förmåga att se hela lösningen och förstå beroenden mellan applikationer, plattformar och integrationer
* erfarenhet av att leda lösningsdiskussioner, utvärdera alternativ och driva arkitekturella beslut
* mycket god förmåga att kommunicera med såväl verksamhet och kund som utvecklare och tekniska specialister
* trygghet i att arbeta i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter, beroenden och förändrade förutsättningar
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Extra intressant är erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och Power Platform  
Vi ser det som starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 och Power Platform, särskilt om du har designat lösningar där plattformarna behöver samverka med andra verksamhetssystem.  
Det kan exempelvis handla om lösningsarkitektur kring:  
Dynamics 365 • Power Platform • Power Apps • Power Automate • Dataverse • API Management • Integrationer • Azure  
  
Du behöver inte vara specialist eller utvecklare inom samtliga tekniker. Vi söker framför allt dig som förstår hur plattformarna kan användas som delar av en större lösning och hur integrationer, data och övriga verksamhetssystem behöver hänga ihop.  
  
Det är också meriterande om du har  

* erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och Microsofts bredare plattformsekosystem
* erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA, framför allt ur ett lösnings-, arkitektur- eller integrationsperspektiv
* erfarenhet av större digitaliserings- eller transformationsprogram där flera system, plattformar och verksamhetsområden berörs
* arbetat i miljöer där Microsoft-plattformar, ERP, CRM och andra verksamhetssystem behöver integreras till en sammanhängande lösning.

  
Vem är du?  
För oss är det viktigt att du kan skapa både riktning och samsyn.  
Du är lösningsorienterad och driver frågor framåt även när alla svar ännu inte finns på plats. Du kan snabbt skapa dig en bild av helheten och är pragmatisk när du behöver balansera verksamhetsnytta, tekniska möjligheter, tid, kostnad och långsiktig förvaltning.  
Du är kommunikativ och pedagogisk och kan växla mellan att diskutera verksamhetsprocesser med kunden och tekniska vägval med arkitekter och utvecklare.  
Samtidigt är du prestigelös. Du behöver inte själv äga varje teknisk detalj, utan vet när andra kompetenser ska involveras och får olika specialister att arbeta mot samma mål.  
  
Varför CGI?  
Hos CGI får du möjlighet att arbeta med affärskritiska lösningar och komplexa digitala transformationer hos några av våra kunder. Du får kombinera din arkitekturkompetens med CGI breda kompetens inom bland annat Microsoft, integration, ERP, cloud och verksamhetsutveckling.  
Som Senior Lösningsarkitekt får du möjlighet att påverka lösningen från tidigt skede och arbeta nära både kund och våra leveransteam.  
Du blir samtidigt en del av ett stort nätverk av arkitekter, utvecklare och specialister där vi delar kunskap och tillsammans löser komplexa utmaningar.  
  
Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta t.karlsson@cgi.com. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!  
  
#LI-HW1

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**  
  
Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.  
  
Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.  
  
Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.  
  
Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
  
  
Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

jobs.title: Systemutvecklare Fullstack
jobs.description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

 **Jobbeskrivning**

**Är du en helt vanlig eller ovanlig back-end-utvecklare, som vill ha roligt på jobbet, samarbeta med andra, bidra med din kompetens, ha en stöttande chef och vara del av ett riktigt härligt team i Stockholm?** **Bra, för precis det kan vi erbjuda dig!**

I din roll som konsult kommer du att vara ansvarig för att utveckla och underhålla back-end-komponenter i olika projekt. Rollen innebär att arbeta både självständigt och i team, t.ex. genom att ensam eller tillsammans med kollegor ta ansvar för hela back-end-delen av ett projekt.

Vi driver både små och stora projekt från Stockholm och har kunder inom flera olika branscher, t.ex. offentlig sektor och samhällsviktig verksamhet. Din vardag kommer se lite olika ut beroende på projekt, kund och uppdrag - och den variationen tror jag att du tycker känns kul!

 **Kvalifikationer**

Dina tekniska färdigheter är förstås viktiga men vad du har att bidra med som person är lika viktigt det. I den här rollen behöver du t.ex. trivas med att samarbeta i team och dela ut och ta emot feedback, tycka att det är intressant när omständigheter förändras (t.ex. att du behöver lära dig en ny teknik eller nya arbetsuppgifter, byta kund, team eller projekt etc.), du motiveras av att hjälpa andra (t.ex. föreslå en teknisk förändring som är till hjälp för kunden) och du drar dig inte för att själv ta hjälp om du kör fast.

**För att komma in med rätt tekniska förutsättningar tror vi att du:**

* Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av C#/.NET-utveckling
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med REST API:er
* Har erfarenhet av Azure och kunskap om DevOps och dess processer
* Har erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server

**Meriterande:**

* Erfarenhet av WPF
* Erfarenhet av containerteknik (Podman, Kubernetes)
* Erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD)
* Erfarenhet av GIS

Utöver det är du svensk medborgare\* och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift, då svenska krävs i kontakt med kollegor och kunder. Ett extra plus i kanten om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult!

* *För vissa uppdrag hos myndighet, region eller kommun krävs svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning.*

**Rebecka Gravås**, Gruppchef  
rebecka.gravas@afry.com

I alla våra rekryteringsprocesser använder vi oss av kompetensbaserad rekrytering - för en rättvis och träffsäker rekrytering. Följande steg ingår i den här processen:

* Telefonavstämning eller urvalsfrågor

* Referenstagning
* Erbjudande

* En attraktiv arbetsmiljö med fokus på trivsel och utveckling. Du får utvecklas kontinuerligt genom uppdrag, utbildning och individuella kompetensplaner.
* Konkurrenskraftiga villkor med förmåner som kollektivavtal, friskvård, företagsrabatter, pensionsplanering och generösa föräldraledighetsregler.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Software Architect with a strong background in C#/.NET and a passion for building solutions that make a real difference? Join us at Epiroc and help shape the architecture behind innovative digital solutions for sustainable mining and construction. In this role, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with the ability to guide, mentor and bring others forward.

  

**It all starts with people. People like you.**

  

**Join our team**

You will join an IoT Platform organization - an international, diverse, and highly collaborative environment where software developers, architects, and product owners work side‑by‑side to enable the next generation of data‑driven solutions. Together, we build the platform that collects machine data and transforms it into real value for customers and internal stakeholders across Epiroc.

  

**Your mission**

First our product manager(s) define “the What”. Then a key part in this architect role will be to contribute with “the How”. Your mission is to take an active role in shaping and developing the software architecture within the teams while also staying close to the development work. You will work for solutions that are well designed, sustainable and aligned with both current and future needs. Together with our Lead Architect and fellow architect colleagues you will form a strong architectural team that relentlessly implements and follows up on a solid architectural roadmap and ways of working. This role will start to focus on one of our development teams and then gradually expand its responsibility towards several teams.

  

In this role, you will:

* Drive and contribute to good software architecture
* Support architectural discussions and technical decision-making
* Be involved in creating the architectural style and then heavily contributing towards the architectural patterns, design patterns and design principles
* Designs end-to-end IT solutions that align with business goals
* Work with C#/.NET IoT solutions such as file transfer, device management & data handling and more towards cloud rather than machine
* Collaborate closely with developers, teams and other internal stakeholders
* Contribute to continuous improvement and bring new perspectives into the team
* Balance hands-on contribution with guiding others in their technical development
* Designs software components and modules
* Set coding standards
* Solve technical challenges like code scalability, maintainability, security and performance

  

**Your profile**

You enjoy collaborating with others, sharing your knowledge and helping the team move forward while still contributing strongly to the technical delivery. You bring solid software architecture experience, new perspectives and a positive, engaging approach.

  

We believe you have:

* At least 5 years of experience as a software architect or in software development with a lead role in software architecture matters
* Experience working in roles where you have contributed to architectural direction, technical design, senior-level development or set up complex foundations that other teams could built their deliveries upon
* Very strong knowledge in C#/.NET
* The ability and interest to support developers
* Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset
* A positive and engaging approach

  

**Location and other**

This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. While we offer a hybrid workplace, you would be required to be in the office minimum of 3 days per week.

  

**Why Epiroc?**

By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth and lasting impact.

  

To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:

  

* Global career opportunities
* Learning & Development programs
* Benefits package, including variable compensation
* Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Community involvement

  

**Application and contact information**

We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 23, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date.

  

We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

  

For questions about the position, please contact:

Hiring Manager, Carl Slotte, carl.slotte@external.epiroc.com

  

For questions about the recruitment process, please contact:

Recruitment Specialist, Zuzana Matova, zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com

  

**It all starts with people.** The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

jobs.title: Masters Thesis Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Search Specialist)
jobs.description:
We are looking for hardworking technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to craft and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of hardworking software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales reps and play a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

As MongoDB continues to expand product offerings and features within the MongoDB Atlas Data Platform, MongoDB is seeking an expert in application search. This role will focus on being a product specialist of Atlas Search within the presales organization. Beyond the normal tasks of a MongoDB Solutions Architect, this specialist role will operate in a worldwide team, assist in the most complex search deal cycles, assist in search enablement, and work closely with the Atlas Search product team to close the feedback loop and further enhance the product moving forward. This includes both lexical and semantic search offerings.

This role will be based remotely in Barcelona, Dublin & London.

### **As an ideal candidate, you will have**

* 3+ years of search expertise (Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, Algolia, Lucidworks, or similar)
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 3+ years of pre-sales experience with enterprise software
* Solid understanding and ability to code with two or more modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, etc) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C, C++, C#, Java, etc)
* Experience with scalable and highly available distributed systems
* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time

### **You may also have**

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* A MongoDB Certification
* A major cloud provider certification

### **What you do at MongoDB**

* Design systems, applications, and infrastructure to help drive software development projects using MongoDB and the Atlas Developer Data Platform (DDP)
* Advise customers on architectures, patterns, and strategies for making the best use of MongoDB
* Expertly articulate the business value of MongoDB solutions
* Align to support sales with activities such as technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentation, sizing, and documentation of technical decision criteria; working across a number of opportunities in parallel
* Translate technical concepts and patterns into business benefits for management and executives
* Act as a liaison, collecting feedback from the field to relay back to the Product Management team
* Help drive demand through participation in both industry-known trade-shows as well account-based marketing events
* Demonstrate resilience and sound judgment in dealing with business challenges
* Proactively seek opportunities to support and mentor other pre-sales team members and share standard methodologies
* Help enable other solutions architects with knowledge on search technical and business concepts as well as build tools to allow other SAs to demonstrate these concepts
* Assist in the direction of Vector Search and AI/ML through taking customer needs and interactions to Product Management
* Embody MongoDB's core values in our interactions with internal teams and customers

### **What you will learn**

* The rapidly growing MongoDB product suite, including
* Core database server
* Atlas (fully managed cloud database service)
* The Atlas Developer Data Platform including Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, Atlas for the Edge, Realm, Charts, and Atlas Streams Processing
* Other Tools and connectors - Ops/Cloud Manager, Compass, Connector for BI, Connector for Spark
* Market-relevant, complementary technologies e.g. Apache Kafka, Kubernetes
* Modern and popular architecture design patterns, methodologies and concerns e.g. microservices, DevOps, cloud, security

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
