jobs.description:
**Test Automation Engineer**

**Location –** Remote anywhere from Republic of Ireland

**Contract type -** Permanent Fulltime

**Work model –** Remote

**Working hours -** (Monday to Thursday 8:30am -5:30pm and Friday 8:30am -3:15pm)

  

***\* We can only consider applicants eligible to work full-time in the Republic of Ireland.***

***Candidates must be based in the Republic of Ireland***

  

Our client is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation

  

You will be working within and promoting the Company Values – Be Brave, Be Wise, Be Proud and Exceed.

  

**Role Overview**
=================

You will design, build and own the automated testing capability underpinning releases for a B2B SaaS platform serving enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will be responsible for replacing manual test execution with reliable, maintainable automation integrated into CI/CD pipelines, and for raising the overall quality engineering standard of the team.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Automation design and development**
-------------------------------------

* Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks covering functional, regression, API and end-to-end scenarios.

* Develop and maintain automated test suites for web applications, REST APIs and platform integrations.

* Identify existing manual test cases suitable for automation, prioritise them by risk and effort, and systematically convert them.

* Build and manage the test data, environments and fixtures needed to run suites reliably and repeatably.

  

**CI/CD and quality engineering**
---------------------------------

* Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines so that quality feedback is delivered on every build.

* Define and maintain quality gates, coverage targets and release criteria alongside engineering leads.

* Monitor suite health, investigate and eliminate flaky tests, and keep execution times within acceptable limits.

* Report on quality metrics — coverage, pass rates, defect escape rates — and use them to drive improvement.

  

**Quality assurance and collaboration**
---------------------------------------

* Work with developers, DevOps and product stakeholders to define acceptance criteria and testable requirements from the outset.

* Perform exploratory and risk-based testing where automation is not appropriate, and carry out root-cause analysis on escaped defects.

* Support non-functional testing, including performance, load and security-related validation.

* Mentor colleagues in automation practice and promote quality ownership across the wider team.

* Evaluate and adopt new tooling, including AI-assisted testing approaches, where it demonstrably improves coverage or reduces effort.

  

**Education**
=============

* A technology, engineering or computer science related bachelor’s degree, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

  

**Mandatory Candidate Requirements**
====================================

* 4+ years’ experience in test automation within a commercial software or B2B SaaS environment.

* Strong programming ability in at least one of Python, Java, C# or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the capability to build and maintain a framework rather than only write scripts.

* Hands-on experience with modern UI automation tooling such as Playwright, Selenium or Cypress.

* Demonstrable experience automating API and integration testing (for example REST Assured, Postman/Newman, pytest or equivalent).

* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps, and working with source control and branching workflows.

* Solid grounding in test design: risk-based prioritisation, coverage analysis, and knowing what should and should not be automated.

* Experience working in an Agile development environment.

* Native proficiency in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Desirable but not Mandatory**
===============================

* Performance and load testing experience (JMeter, k6, Locust or similar).

* Working knowledge of Azure cloud services, containerisation and infrastructure-as-code.

* SQL and database testing experience.

* Experience with AI-assisted test generation, maintenance or triage tooling.

* Security testing awareness (for example OWASP fundamentals).

* ISTQB or equivalent certification.

  

**What about you?**
===================

This is the most important part. The role suits an engineer who takes genuine ownership of quality, is curious about why defects occur rather than just that they did, and who wants to build something durable rather than patch what exists.

You will be joining a collaborative and highly regarded team where engineering standards are taken seriously, so we are looking for people who understand what it takes to sustain that.

  
  
  

**Why Join Us?**

  

Ready to be a part of our dynamic team? Explore exciting opportunities with Covalen – where your skills, ideas, and achievements are celebrated!

  

Covalen, we champion diversity and equality, anchoring our workplace cultures and creative minds. We recognize the collective strength found in the diverse backgrounds, skills, and experiences of our team members. Our commitment to fostering an inclusive environment transcends gender, marital status, family status, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, and membership in the Travelling community.

  

For more information, don't hesitate to reach out at: aline.telles@covalensolutions.com and your journey to becoming a valued part of Covalen starts here.

jobs.title: Business Application Architect Headquarters
jobs.description:
**Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?**

**About Cambi**

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 120 million individuals across more than 28 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

**About the Role**

As a Business Applications Architect, you will be the technical owner of Cambi's Microsoft 365 landscape, ERP, CRM, and the integrations connecting them. You will translate business needs into platform functionality, aligned with the strategic direction for each system, and own the overall technical architecture across the full life-cycle of the platforms and their integrations – from design and implementation to ongoing evolution. This includes safeguarding the integrity, quality, and availability of the company's data as it flows across these platforms. The responsibility spans from high-level architectural direction to hands-on technical implementation, ensuring that strategic intent and operational detail remain consistently connected.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technically own the core business platforms and execute life-cycle enhancements to create business value.
* Define and maintain architectural principles, standards, and documentation for Cambi’s core business applications and integrations.
* Understand and translate business needs and foster cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure key processes have optimal system support.
* Ensure technical changes are assessed and implemented with appropriate consideration for scalability, maintainability, security, data integrity, and life-cycle impact.
* Embed data-driven thinking into architecture and technical decisions.
* Operate within Cambi’s IT strategy, portfolio, priorities, and budget.

**We are looking for**

* A data-first and data-driven mindset with a holistic way of thinking.
* A consistent focus on ensuring that technology investments translate into tangible and measurable business value.
* A genuine interest in platform solutions and the broader ecosystem they are part of.
* A real appreciation for collaboration and cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* A curious, technology-enthusiast approach to the work, with the drive and energy to help shape the role going forward.
* Confident leading and participating in well-defined processes and appropriately scoped projects.
* Willing to challenge the status quo, yet grounded and humble in how you do it.
* Not afraid to get your hands dirty with day-to-day operational work, coding, and configuration.

**Key qualifications and requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications and/or operational expertise within platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, ERP (platform-agnostic), CRM (Salesforce), integration development, and master data.
* Significant, demonstrable experience in a comparable role is equally valid and will be given weight against formal education requirements.
* Experience owning technical architecture and systems within a business context.
* Experience in integration development, ideally with a background in software development (full-stack or backend).
* Experience with system configuration and customization.
* Experience with data platform architecture and the data engineering layer.
* Hands-on skills in programming, scripting (PowerShell), and low-code (Power Automate, Power Apps) development within the ecosystem.
* Experience with development methodology, including backlog and priority management.
* Methodical project management experience, ideally from platform implementations or major upgrades.

At Cambi, we value people who share our commitment to the environment and the positive impact of the circular economy. Your personality should align with Cambi’s core philosophy, which centers around strong customer focus, delivering a high standard of quality in our solutions, products, and services, and always acting with integrity.

**Why Join Cambi**

* **Work globally:** Encounter different cultures and work practices when working with the global organization.
* **Make an impact:** Contribute to projects transforming organic waste streams into bioresources, boosting the circular economy, and leading to net-zero emissions in cities worldwide.
* **Immerse in diversity:** Join a multicultural team with a mix of young and experienced colleagues from more than 25 countries and 18 different disciplinary backgrounds.
* **Grow personally:** Embrace our values: quality, curious, reliable and teamwork, in a dynamic work environment grounded in a modern Code of Conduct applying to all employees and business partners.

**How to Apply**

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with us, we’d love to hear from you. We kindly ask you to upload your CV and answer three questions regarding your motivation for the role.

Delivering on our mission to enable a swift global transition to sustainable communities is contingent on attracting and retaining talented employees from diverse backgrounds.

Deadline for applying is the **18th of October 2026.** Please be informed that we will only accept and assess applications through our career site.

**Contact**

For any questions about the role, you’re welcome to get in touch with:

* Kim Garberg, mob. 908 70 136, kim.garberg@cambi.com

**Curious about software development and subsea technology? Join Kongsberg Discovery as a Full-Stack SW Developer!**

Kongsberg Discovery is a global leader in advanced marine and subsea technologies. To meet an exciting and increasingly demanding future, we are seeking a new colleague to join our Positioning and Monitoring R&D department.

You will become part of the team responsible for HiPOS, our new software platform for operating and monitoring hydroacoustic positioning and communication systems. HiPOS supports demanding maritime operations by presenting positioning information and enabling interaction with hydroacoustic, inertial navigation and associated vessel systems.

Our solutions are used worldwide in demanding maritime operations within research, offshore energy, and other specialized applications.

More information can be found on our web site, search for products like HiPAP and cNODE:

KONGSBERG - an international technology group

**In this role**

You will contribute to the continued development of the HiPOS platform, primarily back-end software, system interfaces, operational user interfaces, and new functionality. You will work closely with experienced software developers, system engineers, testers, and product management in a multidisciplinary R&D environment. You will also:

* Build and improve end-to-end product features across frontend and backend
* Develop scalable backend services, APIs, integrations and data flows
* Contribute to software architecture, system design, security, release and technical specifications
* Troubleshoot and improve software performance, reliability, and usability
* Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines
* Participate in product testing in our laboratories and aboard our research vessels in Horten
* Work closely with Product, UX, Platform, Data and DevOps colleagues to turn user and business needs into working software

**Required qualifications and experience**

* BSc or MSc in computer science, cybernetics, software engineering, or a related field
* Experience with application development using technologies such as C++, C#
* Real-time programming, real time operating systems
* Experience with DevOps tools and development pipelines
* Experience with software development principles, testing, and version control
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

**Preferred qualifications and experience**

* Experience with software architecture, remote operation, networking, or cloud infrastructure is an advantage
* Relevant professional experience is preferred, but recent graduates with a strong technical background will also be considered

*This employment may require security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority, clearance through Civil Aviation Authority or a background check. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.*

**Personal Attributes**

We believe the ideal candidate:

* Is proactive, self-driven, and takes responsibility for assigned tasks
* Approaches problems methodically and systematically
* Enjoys learning new technologies and understanding complex systems
* Collaborates and communicates effectively within multidisciplinary teams
* Contributes ideas and identifies practical solutions to technical challenge
* Values software quality, reliability, and continuous improvement

At **KONGSBERG**, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

**What We Can Offer**

As a Full-Stack Software Developer at Kongsberg Discovery, you will play an important role in developing advanced positioning technology for demanding maritime applications. We offer:

* The opportunity to work with a new software platform and influence its future development
* Challenging technical assignments with real-world maritime applications
* An international and multidisciplinary working environment
* Access to experienced colleagues and strong technical communities
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* Competitive compensation, insurance, and pension schemes
* Flexible working hours and hybrid working arrangements
* The opportunity to contribute to sustainable ocean technology that protects people and planet

**Work location**

Horten. Lysaker may be considered as a work location, but it will be required to be at our Horten site when needed.

**Point of contact**

Henriette Melsom, Department Manager, tel: +4748883011

**About KONGSBERG**

KONGSBERG protects people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space.

We deliver advanced ocean and space technologies – from autonomous marine systems to satellites and data services – supporting sustainability, climate monitoring, infrastructure protection, and security. KONGSBERG also develop innovative technologies for defence, security, and surveillance markets, combining military and civilian expertise. Our defence and security solutions span missiles, weapon stations, air defence, command and control, and digital towers.

Today, we have more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and the Norwegian government controls about 50.01 percent of the shares.

**About Discovery**

The Discovery division develops technologies for sustainable ocean resource management, climate monitoring, critical infrastructure protection, and national security. Its technology platforms and solutions support offshore operations, fisheries, ocean research, maritime operations, sea-based energy production, and naval defence. Products include sonars, underwater communication equipment, satellites, surveillance and positioning systems, and autonomous vehicles. The world needs a sustainable energy future. Achieving net‑zero emissions is a tremendous challenge, and subsea technology has a critical and exciting role to play. That’s why we at OneSubsea need pioneers and visionaries. Problem‑solvers and collaborators. Curious minds and innovators. Experts and apprentices who care, work together, and drive us forward. OneSubsea is a world‑leading provider of subsea technology, enabling efficient utilization of energy resources and accelerating the transition to a more sustainable future.

We are now looking for a **Control System Software Engineer** to join our team in **Bergen, Sandsli**.

#### **About the role**

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced subsea production systems in the world. As a Control Systems Engineer with SLB OneSubsea, you're not just designing control logic, you're helping to enable the safe and efficient operation of subsea energy infrastructure that operates thousands of meters below the ocean surface.

You'll work with cutting-edge subsea control systems, automation, communications, and power distribution technologies. The role combines software, hardware, systems engineering, and real-world operational challenges, making it highly technical and intellectually stimulating.

SLB OneSubsea offers a unique environment where engineers are involved throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept development and design to testing, commissioning, and field support. This means you can see the direct impact of your work on major global projects.

The company also has a strong international footprint, giving you exposure to global teams, customers, and projects. If you're looking for a role where you can develop both deep technical expertise and broader project and customer-facing skills, this is a great platform.

#### **Key responsibilities include**

* Designing, implementing, and testing control system software for subsea systems

* Performing modifications and upgrades to delivered control systems through aftermarket activities

* Participating in component, functional, system, and interface testing

* Working closely with suppliers during testing activities at supplier locations

* Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams across all project phases

* Supporting implementation and handover of control system software for subsea products and systems

#### **We are looking for someone who**

Is excited by the opportunity to work with industry-leading subsea technology and contribute to solutions that support a more sustainable energy future. This role offers the chance to tackle complex engineering challenges while collaborating with highly skilled colleagues across multidisciplinary teams in an environment that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous development.

The ideal candidate holds as a minimum a BSc in automation, cybernetics, computer science, IT, or a related engineering discipline. Experience with PLC-based control systems is considered a strong advantage, however we also value relevant practical experience and transferable skills and encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds to apply.

#### **Required experience**

* Has minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience

* Is fluent in English, both spoken and written

* Has a positive, practical, and solution-oriented mindset with high drive and strong capacity to deliver

* Can work both independently and as part of multidisciplinary teams

#### **It is a bonus if you have**

* Experience with Rockwell Automation products (e.g. Allen-Bradley PLCs or FactoryTalk View HMI software)

* Experience with Hyper-V virtualization or VMware solutions

* Experience with Microsoft Windows Server

jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production?** Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

jobs.title: Software Engineer til Advertisement & Partner Management i TV 2 Teknologi
jobs.description:
### **Vil du bygge løsninger, som har direkte betydning for TV 2s forretning?**

I Advertisement & Partner Management udvikler vi de systemer, der gør det muligt at planlægge, booke og håndtere reklamer på TV 2s platforme. Det er et område med stor betydning for forretningen, høj kompleksitet og gode muligheder for at skabe mærkbare resultater.

Vi søger en software engineer med nogle års erfaring, som kan bygge gode løsninger og trives i et team, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og godt arbejdsmiljø går hånd i hånd.

Du bliver en del af et område i udvikling. Vi moderniserer vores løsninger, bygger nye cloud-baserede services og udforsker, hvordan AI og agentiske workflows kan blive en naturlig del af softwareudviklingen. Derfor leder vi efter en kollega, der er nysgerrig på teknologi og har lyst til at bidrage til fællesskabet.

### **Rollen**

Som Software Engineer arbejder du tæt sammen med udviklere, product management, designere og forretningen.

Du får ansvar og medbestemmelse fra dag ét og bliver en del af et miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at komme i mål. Vi forventer ikke, at du har svar på alt, men vi håber, at du er nysgerrig, stiller spørgsmål og bidrager til teamets udvikling.

Vi arbejder blandt andet med .NET/C#, API'er og cloud-løsninger på AWS og er i gang med at modernisere vores systemlandskab mod en mere serviceorienteret arkitektur.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

* udvikle og videreudvikle backend-services og API'er.
* arbejde med integrationer, databaser og forretningskritiske dataflows.
* bidrage til tekniske beslutninger og løbende forbedringer.
* tage ansvar for opgaver fra analyse og udvikling til test, release og drift.
* samarbejde tæt med udviklere, product management og forretningen.
* anvende AI-værktøjer og moderne udviklingsmetoder i hverdagen.

### **Teamet**

Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med software engineers, designere, product management og tæt kontakt til forretningen.

Vi har stor tillid til hinanden og lægger vægt på, at det skal være både fagligt spændende og rart at gå på arbejde. Det er helt almindeligt at bede om hjælp, sparre om løsninger og dele idéer undervejs.

Vi tager vores arbejde seriøst, men ikke os selv alt for højtideligt. Derfor håber vi også, at du bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og har lyst til at dele viden, skabe energi og hjælpe med at gøre teamet til et sted, hvor folk ser frem til at møde ind.

Uanset om du motiveres af kode, teknologi, domæneforståelse eller samarbejde med mennesker, får du mulighed for at udvikle dig og bidrage til løsningerne.

Det primære arbejdssted er Teglholmen i København.

### **Din profil**

Du har nogle års erfaring som software engineer og er klar til at tage ansvar for både løsninger og samarbejde.

Du behøver ikke at have prøvet det hele før. Det vigtigste er, at du er dygtig til dit håndværk, har lyst til at lære nyt og motiveres af at skabe værdi sammen med andre.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* har erfaring med backend-udvikling i .NET/C#.
* har arbejdet med API'er, integrationer og databaser.
* har erfaring med moderne softwareudvikling og god kodekvalitet.
* har arbejdet med cloud-platforme/AWS.
* arbejder struktureret med Git, test og samarbejde omkring kode.
* er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og AI-understøttet softwareudvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du også har erfaring med:

* JavaScript eller TypeScript.
* React eller andre moderne frontend-frameworks.
* messaging og eventbaserede arkitekturer.
* GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes og Terraform.
* Power Platform, Dynamics og Umbraco.

### **Hvem håber vi, du er?**

Du er typen, der:

* får tingene til at ske uden at skulle have alting perfekt på forhånd.
* er nysgerrig og har lyst til hele tiden at lære nyt.
* hjælper andre og selv beder om hjælp, når det giver mening.
* bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.
* kan lide at samarbejde med mennesker, der tænker anderledes end dig selv.
* synes, at det er sjovere at vinde som hold end alene.

Vi søger en kollega, som har lyst til at være en del af et fagligt dygtigt team, bidrage med sine kompetencer og gøre hverdagen bedre for de mennesker, man arbejder sammen med.

### **TV 2 som teknologiarbejdsplads**

I TV 2s teknologiorganisation arbejder over 320 specialister hver dag med at udvikle hele den teknologiske værdikæde – fra avanceret medieteknologi og liveproduktion til digitale produkter som apps, streamingtjenester, dataløsninger og brugeroplevelser. Det er her, vi omsætter målet om personlig public service til konkrete løsninger, som møder danskernes behov på tværs af platforme.

Vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams – med bl.a. Software Engineers, UX‑designere, Enterprise Architects, konfigurationsspecialister og Data Scientists – og vi har fokus på kvalitet, tilgængelighed, performance og sikkerhed i alt, hvad vi bygger og driver. Du får kolleger i både Odense på Kvægtorvet og i København på Teglholmen samt en kultur, hvor læring, videndeling og ansvar går hånd i hånd med dynamikken i Danmarks største mediehus.

### **Søg stillingen**

Du sender dit CV og en kort motivation via formularen nedenfor. Ansøgningsfrist er d.12.oktober, hvorefter vi inviterer til samtaler.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Technical Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

**Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen**

**Technical Solution Architect – .NET, Microservices & Integrations**

Are you a technically strong Solution Architect who can turn complex system landscapes into robust, maintainable solutions – while remaining close enough to the code to guide implementation?

Twoday is looking for an experienced Technical Solution Architect for a permanent position in our Digital Engineering business unit. Your first assignment will be with a major Danish public-sector organisation in Copenhagen, where you will help shape solutions across multiple business-critical systems, integrations and delivery partners.

**Your role**

You will act as a trusted technical adviser to the customer and help ensure that proposed solutions are technically sound, realistic and aligned with the wider system landscape.

This is not a purely strategic or documentation-focused architecture role. You must understand the technology in depth, engage directly with developers and contribute actively from clarification and solution design through implementation and operation.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Designing scalable solutions based on .NET, microservices, APIs and asynchronous messaging
* Understanding complex system landscapes, dependencies and technical constraints
* Driving technical clarifications across system owners, development teams and external suppliers
* Assessing, challenging and improving solution recommendations from delivery partners
* Defining clear service boundaries, interfaces, integration patterns and data ownership
* Ensuring robust error handling, retries, idempotency and traceability across distributed systems
* Supporting developers through technical sparring, design reviews and code-level discussions
* Contributing to architecture decisions, technical documentation and implementation plans
* Ensuring that operations, monitoring, logging, security and maintainability are addressed from the outset
* Promoting automated testing, CI/CD and efficient delivery practices
* Using AI-assisted development tools to increase delivery speed without compromising quality, security or correctness

**What we are looking for**

You have several years of experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Lead or senior software engineer with significant architectural responsibility. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate clearly and move complex discussions towards concrete decisions.

**We expect you to have:**

* A strong hands-on background in C# and modern .NET
* Experience with microservices, distributed systems and integration-heavy solutions
* Solid experience designing and implementing REST APIs
* Experience with message-based integration, preferably RabbitMQ or comparable technologies
* A practical understanding of retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency, ordering and duplicate messages
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing
* Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing and operational troubleshooting
* The ability to translate business and technical requirements into workable solution designs
* Experience advising customers and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* The confidence to challenge proposed solutions constructively and explain technical trade-offs
* Experience coordinating dependencies across teams, systems or external suppliers
* A structured and independent approach, with ownership from initial clarification to implementation
* Practical experience using AI tools as part of software development

Experience from public-sector or other complex, regulated environments is an advantage.

**Practical requirements**

* **You are fluent in Danish, both spoken and written**
* **You can work full time onsite with the customer in Copenhagen**
* You are interested in permanent employment with Twoday
* We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible

**About Twoday**

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions. You will also have the flexibility to occasionally work from one of our main offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki or Vilnius.

**Diversity & inclusion**

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

RDG (Risk Decision Group) provides nationwide background investigations compliant with national government standards to include support of continuous vetting for over 110 government agencies.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking an experienced **AWS Cloud Security Engineer** to design, build, and operate security controls for a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized AWS cloud infrastructure supporting Peraton's RDG (Risk Decision Group) program. This is a hands-on role with a key part in day-to-day cloud security operations, embedding secure-by-design principles into cloud architecture, and maintaining continuous FedRAMP compliance.

The engineer is responsible for implementing security architecture, hardening cloud environments, maintaining continuous compliance monitoring, and supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience securing AWS environments within a federal compliance framework (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, RMF, or similar).

**This is a 100% remote position.**

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Design and implement security architecture for AWS workloads aligned with FedRAMP Moderate baseline controls
* Build and maintain security guardrails using AWS-native services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector)
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code security controls (Terraform/CloudFormation) with policy as code
* Support System Security Plans (SSPs), ATO activities, and POA&M remediation
* Perform continuous monitoring, vulnerability scanning, patch management tracking, and monthly/annual assessment support
* Configure and maintain centralized logging, SIEM integration, and audit trail retention per FedRAMP/NIST requirements
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, service control policies (SCPs), and cross-account access controls.
* Manage encryption at rest and in transit (KMS, ACM, TLS enforcement) per FIPS 140-2/140-3 requirements where applicable
* Respond to security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support cloud-specific incident response playbooks
* Collaborate with DevOps/Platform teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps)
* Maintain documentation for control implementation statements, architecture diagrams, and audit evidence
* Support boundary definition and system categorization activities (FIPS 199) as required

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* US citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret eligible clearance
* Minimum 8 years work experience with BS/BA in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS engineering experience, with 3+ years specifically in cloud security roles
* Demonstrated experience working within a FedRAMP Moderate or FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, or equivalent federal compliance environment
* Experience supporting or maintaining an SSP and RMF processes
* Experience with AWS GovCloud (US), AWS Commercial, or equivalent federal AWS environments
* Strong hands-on expertise with AWS security services: IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector, and Systems Manager
* Solid understanding of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, SI, etc.) and the ability to map implementations to specific controls
* 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation), including security scanning and policy-as-code tools
* Networking security fundamentals: VPC design, security groups, NACLs, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, and network segmentation for compliance boundaries
* Experience with vulnerability management tools (AWS Inspector or similar) and remediation tracking
* Experience implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in AWS
* Familiarity with SIEM/log aggregation tools (Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, OpenSearch, or similar) for security event monitoring
* Scripting ability in Python or Bash for automating compliance checks and remediation
* Understanding of encryption standards relevant to federal systems (FIPS 140-2/140-3, TLS 1.2+)
* One of the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (with a security focus), or CISSP, CISM, or Security+ (with strong AWS hands-on experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct experience supporting a Peraton program or similar federal integrator (Leidos, Booz Allen, SAIC, General Dynamics IT, etc.)
* Familiarity with server and systems hardening software
* Experience with container security (ECS/EKS), including image scanning (ECR scanning) and runtime protection
* Experience with AWS Control Tower and multi-account landing zone security governance
* Experience automating compliance evidence collection for continuous ATO (cATO)
* Prior experience with change management processes in a regulated/audited environment
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field
* Active security clearance
* Experience with AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock)
* Experience with hybrid/multi-cloud architecture, including Azure (VNets, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Policy, ExpressRoute)
* Experience with Microsoft .NET
* Experience supporting ATO/continuous monitoring processes
* Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines
* Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks, national security/defense/critical infrastructure missions, and supporting federal agencies or large GovCon programs

#RDG

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. jobs.title: Senior R&D AI Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities:

**About the Team**

You will join a high-performing Keysight R&D team developing next-generation Electronic Design Automation (EDA) workflow solutions for High-Speed Digital (HSD), signal integrity, power integrity, and adjacent simulation-driven engineering domains. The team combines product APIs, simulation knowledge, AI/ML methods, neural-network modeling, and agentic workflow automation to help engineers interact more efficiently with complex design tools.

**About the Job**

As a Senior AI Software Development Engineer, you will develop agentic AI capabilities that connect large language models, EDA applications, simulation engines, product APIs, knowledge sources, and user workflows. Your work will enable supervised, goal-driven automation where AI agents can plan, invoke tools, reason over results, and assist with repeatable design-analysis tasks.

* Build and maintain MCP-enabled agent infrastructure, including servers, clients, skills, tool schemas, orchestration services, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks.
* Translate EDA workflow use cases into reliable AI-agent capabilities, such as simulation setup assistance, design diagnostics, optimization workflows, compliance-test setup, report generation, and guided automation.
* Apply neural-network techniques where appropriate, including surrogate modeling, embeddings, vector search, model evaluation, physics-aware or data-driven models, and AI-based acceleration of expensive simulation workflows.
* Develop production-quality backend services in Python and/or other modern languages with strong attention to reliability, observability, testing, maintainability, and secure deployment.

Qualifications:

**Technical Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python, with experience building production-grade services, libraries, automation tools, or developer-facing APIs.
* Hands-on experience with AI-agent or copilot-style solutions using LLMs, tool calling/function calling, planner-executor patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Practical knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), including server/client concepts, tools, resources, prompts, schema design, secure tool invocation, and local or remote deployment patterns.
* Experience with AI/ML and neural-network concepts relevant to engineering workflows, such as deep learning, surrogate models, embeddings, vector databases, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and context management.
* Strong grasp of modern software-development practices: Agile delivery, Git-based workflows, code review, CI/CD, automated testing, package management, security reviews, and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with EDA, CAD, simulation, high-speed digital design, signal integrity, power integrity, RF/microwave design, photonics, or scientific/engineering software.
* Experience with product APIs, desktop application automation, Python scripting inside engineering tools, or integration of AI agents with domain-specific software environments.
* Familiarity with neural-network-based surrogate modeling for accelerating simulation, design-space exploration, optimization, or rapid what-if analysis.
* Familiarity with LLM application frameworks, agent frameworks, vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic search, workflow orchestration platforms, or cloud-based deployment environments.
* Exposure to C++, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript is beneficial when integrating AI services with engineering desktop applications or web-based workflow interfaces.

**Soft Skills & Collaboration**

* Strong collaboration skills across multi-site and multi-cultural teams, including R&D, product management, application engineering, and customer-facing stakeholders.
* Clear written and spoken English communication, with the ability to explain AI-agent architecture, neural-network trade-offs, and engineering workflow impact to both technical and management audiences.
* Ability to guide development teams, mentor junior engineers, and drive pragmatic adoption of AI in production engineering software.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Bioinformatics Scientist (AI-guided protein engineering)
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

**Why us**

Illumina is the global leader in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technology. Through relentless innovation, Illumina has reduced the cost of sequencing a human genome from hundreds of thousands of dollars to below $200. The drastic cost reduction has moved NGS from the laboratory to the clinic, with wide-ranging impact from cancer diagnostics to genetic testing. We invite you to join us in our effort to improve human health by unlocking the power of the genome.

**Position summary**

We are seeking a Senior Staff Scientist to help build computational tools and data foundation for our protein engineering group across global enzyme engineering programs. This role will connect data structures for high-throughput and mid-throughput screening, participate in method development and evaluation, and help establish semi-closed-loop and closed-loop design-build-test-learn workflows.

  

The successful candidate will provide senior technical leadership at the interface of protein engineering, AI/ML design, screening data systems, automation, and experimental execution. This scientist will define how screening results become reusable data assets as well as how computational methods are benchmarked and adopted.

The role is based in Singapore. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of Illumina’s continued growth.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Build reusable data foundations for protein engineering. Define data structures, metadata standards, variant lineage, assay context, controls, replicate handling, uncertainty, and negative data capture across high- and mid-throughput screening workflows.
* Enable model-guided enzyme engineering. Develop and evaluate computational workflows that connect sequence, structure, assay, and screening datasets to AI/ML models, design rationale, variant prioritization, and next-round library design.
* Benchmark computational and AI methods. Assess internal pipelines, open-source methods, commercial protein design platforms, and emerging scientific agents using retrospective and prospective performance metrics relevant to enzyme engineering programs.
* Deliver practical tools for project teams. Create reusable scripts, templates, dashboards, lightweight applications, and analysis pipelines that help experimental and computational teams run routine analyses and interpret recommendations efficiently.
* Advance closed-loop DBTL workflows. Help establish semi-closed-loop and closed-loop design-build-test-learn systems in which experimental results are captured, analyzed, modeled, reviewed, and converted into actionable design recommendations.
* Partner across global engineering programs. Work closely with experimental scientists, automation teams, informatics, software engineering, data engineering, chemists, biophysicists, and platform teams to ensure computational workflows align with assay throughput, operational constraints, and program goals.

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities.

**Education, Experience & Attributes required:**

* Ph.D. in computational chemistry, computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science or related fields, or equivalent work & educational experience.
* Significant experience leading computational biology, protein engineering, AI/ML, screening analytics, or scientific data infrastructure efforts
* Deep experience applying computational or data-driven methods to protein engineering, enzyme engineering, directed evolution, assay analysis, or related biological design problems.
* Demonstrated ability to design data structures or analytical systems that support reproducible analysis, model training, and cross-project learning.
* Wet-lab experience in high-throughput or mid-throughput screening and/or biochemical assay designs.
* Solid programming skills in at least one of the major programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, R).
* In-depth knowledge of protein sequence or structure modelling, protein-ligand interaction predictions and/or molecular simulations.
* Understanding of AI/ML methods and practical experience in adopting AI/ML-driven protein-design models.
* Strong fundamentals in statistical modelling, algorithm design, data analysis, and/or visualization methods.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Collaborative, open and self-aware, team player, and able to rapidly integrate into cross functional teams.
* Highly motivated individual with proven ability in thinking innovatively and the proven track record of productive research and development.

Strong applicants with lesser experience will be considered for a position commensurate with the experience.  



**Preferred experiences and attributes**

* Experience with foundational AI/ML models and protein language models for protein engineering, including generative protein design, zero-shot variant scoring, supervised learning, model-guided library design, denoising and uncertainty-aware learning, and multi-parameter optimization of protein properties

* Experience with structure prediction, protein-ligand or enzyme-substrate modeling, molecular dynamics, docking, or biophysical analysis (e.g. Protein MPNN, RFdiffusion, Boltz, Alphafold)

* Experience developing data standards, assay schemas, dashboards, or lightweight tools for experimental scientists.

* Experience with developing AI agents and agentic workflows for method and application development, and automatic execution and optimization of computational pipelines,
* Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX
* Large-scale biological data analysis using cloud or high-performance computing environments
* Practical experience with AI/ML model development for protein design.
* Experience with experiments within protein engineering, e.g. directed-evolution, high-throughput screening.
* Experience in using one or more commonly used molecular modelling software, e.g. Rosetta.
* Knowledge of best software development practices and code version control, e.g. Git.
* Knowledge of UNIX environment and shell scripting.
* Experience with high-performance computing, job schedulers, and/or GPU computing.
* Broad knowledge of bioinformatics, genomics, and/or proteomics database, tools, and/or algorithms.
* Knowledge of biochemistry, enzymology, and/or molecular biology.
Familiarity with next generation sequencing technologies, tools, and/or workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
As a physician-founded and led organization, ensuring everyone has access to quality healthcare is what inspires us. The magic we’ve created lies in Carbon Health’s custom EHR and the collaboration among clinical teams, engineers, and designers who work side-by-side to deliver innovation like our hands free AI charting tool. That’s why we hire people who genuinely care about patients, solving healthcare challenges, and making a positive impact every day. Join us and help change the future of healthcare for the better.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable services that real clinical workflows depend on. You'll design and own backend systems, APIs, and the event-driven infrastructure that connects them.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take a service from technical design to production, make pragmatic decisions, and collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams.

You'll work with modern JVM technologies, AWS, and event-driven systems in a healthcare technology environment where reliability, data integrity, and delivery matter.

**What you'll do**

* Design, build, and own JVM backend services (Java, Kotlin, or Scala) from technical design through production.
* Build reliable service-to-service communication with gRPC: well-defined contracts, deadlines and timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotent operations, and graceful degradation when a dependency fails.
* Design public and internal APIs (REST, GraphQL)
* Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows that stay consistent under failure, using patterns such as idempotent consumers, dead-letter handling, Saga, and Transactional Outbox.
* Own the infrastructure your services run on: define and evolve it with Terraform, review infrastructure changes like application code, and ship through automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Make services observable with metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting tied to service-level objectives.
* Model data and tune queries in relational databases so performance stays predictable as data grows.
* Handle sensitive healthcare data responsibly through access control, encryption, and audit trails.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code, lead technical design discussions, and help raise the bar through reviews and mentoring.
* Use AI effectively to improve development workflows, from exploration and implementation to testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver features on time.

**Qualifications**

* Strong professional experience building and operating backend systems in production.
* Solid experience with the JVM ecosystem: Java, Kotlin, or Scala.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC or a similar RPC framework for service-to-service communication, including timeouts, retries, and failure handling.
* Experience designing production-grade APIs with REST and GraphQL.
* Experience with event-driven architecture and message queues, and with the delivery and consistency challenges that come with them.
* Solid relational database experience: schema design, indexing, and query performance.
* Hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with Terraform.
* Experience running services in production: observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic approach to engineering decisions.
* Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Professional working proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
* A strong interest in using AI efficiently and responsibly in software development.  
    
  **Nice to have**

* Experience in healthcare technology or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience with healthcare data standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
* Experience with resilience patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, and rate limiting.
* Experience with stream processing or change data capture.
* Experience with containers and container orchestration.
* Some frontend familiarity to collaborate smoothly across the stack.
* Experience contributing to technical architecture and mentoring other engineers.

**What we offer**

* Remote-first, full-time, permanent employment in Türkiye.
* Salary paid in USD, net.
* Payroll employment with the benefits of a permanent position.
* Access to our office at ODTÜ Teknokent, Ankara, with regular visits according to planned schedules.
* 100% private health insurance coverage for the employee.
* 50% private health insurance coverage for eligible family members, if you choose to include them.
* Floating vacation days: when a public holiday falls on a weekend, you can take the corresponding day off on a weekday of your choice, subject to applicable policies.
* The opportunity to work on meaningful healthcare technology products with a collaborative engineering team.
* A culture that values ownership, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality software.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Trainee aan boord
jobs.description:
Over je werkomgeving

Stap aan boord van een van onze nieuwste, ultramoderne schepen en ontdek een wereld op zich. Waar een divers team van stuurmannen, deckhands en scheepskoks tot ingenieurs en elektrotechnici elke dag samenwerkt. Ieder met zijn eigen expertise, maar met één gedeelde drijfveer: samen bouwen aan de wereld van morgen. Samen installeren jullie infrastructuur voor hernieuwbare energie, maken jullie transport over water mogelijk, beschermen jullie onze kusten en bouwen jullie de meest geavanceerde havens. En dat allemaal met de meest geavanceerde vloot en moderne apparatuur.

En binnen dat team zorg jij, samen met je collega’s van de technische crew, ervoor dat alle elektrische systemen aan boord blijven draaien zoals het hoort. Van onderhoud en troubleshooting tot software-optimalisatie: jullie zorgen ervoor dat alles blijft werken.

Wat houdt de rol in

Onze schepen worden steeds slimmer, complexer en geavanceerder. En dus hebben we elektrotechnici nodig die mee zijn met hun tijd. Net afgestudeerd in Elektromechanica of Toegepaste Informatica? Perfect. Jij brengt de nieuwste kennis mee, wij zorgen voor de ervaring, de begeleiding en hypermoderne apparatuur om mee aan de slag te gaan. Jouw rol:

* Je bent mee met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen elektromechanica. Nieuwe technologie? Bring it on.
* Je krijgt energie van techniek waarbij je zowel je handen als je hersenen aan het werk zet.
* Elektrische systemen? Daar weet jij raad mee: van onderhoud en storingen opsporen tot testen, meten en herstellen.
* Je leest vlot elektrische schema’s en technische plannen en weet hoe je elektrische installaties, motoren, generatoren en schakelkasten aanpakt. Geen probleem als je dat nog niet allemaal beheerst: als starter krijg je de ruimte om volop bij te leren en ervaring op te bouwen.
* Automatisatie, PLC’s, netwerken en digitale systemen? Daar wil je meer van weten. Met HMI’s (Human-Machine Interface) krijg je een inkijk in wat er aan boord gebeurt: je navigeert door de systemen, analyseert wat er misgaat en vindt sneller de oorzaak én de oplossing.
* Je denkt graag mee over hoe systemen slimmer, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder kunnen werken.
* Veilig werken staat altijd voorop. Je hebt aandacht voor veilige werkprocedures, lockout/tagout en de juiste manier van werken aan elektrische installaties.

Klinkt als een serieuze boterham?

Dat is het ook. Maar gelukkig hoef je dat niet allemaal alleen te doen. Ons team aan boord gaat samen met jou aan de slag, geeft je kansen om te leren en te groeien en staat altijd voor je klaar wanneer je even wilt ventileren.

Kan je niet wachten om ons te ontmoeten? Maak dan alvast even kennis met onze collega’s Simon en Christof.

**Wat heb je nodig?**

* Een (professionele) bachelor of HBO Bachelor in Elektromechanica, Toegepaste Informatica of Scheepswerktuigkunde ETO
* Vlot in het Engels. Dat is nu eenmaal de voertaal aan boord.
* Een eerste werkervaring is niet nodig.
* Organisatieskills, stressbestendigheid, proactieve houding.
* Geen zeevaartschool of vaarbevoegdheid op zak? Geen probleem. Die heb je voor deze functie niet nodig.

Wat mag je verwachten

* Een boeiende en afwisselende job in een no-nonsense internationale werkomgeving.
* Werken op één van onze bagger- en offshore schepen (rotatiesysteem: 6 weken werken / 6 weken verlof).
* De winnende combinatie tot succesvolle projecten: teamspirit en autonomie.
* Blijvende kansen tot persoonlijke groei.
* Een fijne werkomgeving: van sportfaciliteiten en lekker, gezond eten tot een nette en comfortabele leefomgeving met alles wat je nodig hebt om je thuis te voelen aan boord.

Wij zoeken het schip dat bij je past. We breiden onze vloot steeds uit met high-tech schepen die van alle markten thuis zijn. Zowel op grote als kleinere schepen is er plaats op dek of in de machinekamer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
===============

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

**The Role**
============

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

**What You'll Work On**
=======================

* Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.
* Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.
* Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.
* Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.
* Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.
* Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.
* Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.
* Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

**Who We're Looking For**
=========================

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

**Your Background**
===================

* 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.
* Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.
* Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.
* Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.
* Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.
* Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

**Nice to Have**
================

* ROS 2.
* Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation.
* Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Functional safety or comparable standards work.
* On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience.
* Having been on call for hardware in the field.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.
* Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.
* Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.
* Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.
* Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package
* Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

**#Airports**

AERTEC es una compañía internacional especializada en **tecnología aeroespacial** que desarrolla su actividad en la industria aeroespacial, la defensa y los aeropuertos.

En aeropuertos nos posicionamos como la ingeniería más aeronáutica, interviniendo en el estudio de la inversión, planificación y diseño, asesoría en la operación aeroportuaria y en la mejora de los procesos en área terminal y campo de vuelos. jobs.description:

Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.
  
  
Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group.

### **Your Tasks**

* Design, implement, and maintain reliable automated test suites for web applications, mobile app and microservices aligned with business requirements.
* Collaborate actively within a multidisciplinary, international Squad (Developers, DevOps, UX/UI, Tech Lead, Product Owner, Product Manager) towards continuous delivery and high quality.
* Take ownership of testing strategy within the squad, managing test preparation, execution, and reporting from feature conception to production deployment.
* Perform end-to-end API testing (RESTful services), ensuring functional accuracy, performance, and data integrity.
* Implement and execute BDD (Behavior-Driven Development)
* Build and maintain web and app automation scripts using modern tools like Playwright and Selenium.
* Champion quality assurance best practices and integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with developers to ensure fast and efficient resolution.

### **Your Profile**

* 3+ years of experience working as a Quality Assurance / Test Automation Engineer.
* A native team player capable of working effectively within small, heterogeneous, and agile international teams.
* Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to communicate effectively within an international team and collaborate across different stakeholders.
* Outstanding QA Soft Skills: Strong critical thinking, meticulous attention to detail, constructive communication, and empathy when delivering feedback or documenting defects to foster a collaborative culture with developers.
* Solid hands-on experience in API Testing (REST APIs) using tools like Postman, Bruno, or code-based libraries (Requests, RestAssured, Robot Framework).
* Proven expertise in Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Behave (or similar Gherkin-based frameworks like Cucumber/SpecFlow).
* Strong practical experience in Web UI Automation using Playwright and/or Selenium.
* Good skills in a programming language suitable for automation test frameworks (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#).
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests into deployment flows.
* A proactive and growth-oriented mindset-an eager learner, passionate about continuously advancing their QA skills, exploring new testing tools, and staying up-to-date with quality practices.
* Deep understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, bug life cycle management, and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
* A hands-on mindset-you take ownership of quality and test execution from planning to release

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Search Specialist)
jobs.description:
We are looking for hardworking technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to craft and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of hardworking software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales reps and play a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

As MongoDB continues to expand product offerings and features within the MongoDB Atlas Data Platform, MongoDB is seeking an expert in application search. This role will focus on being a product specialist of Atlas Search within the presales organization. Beyond the normal tasks of a MongoDB Solutions Architect, this specialist role will operate in a worldwide team, assist in the most complex search deal cycles, assist in search enablement, and work closely with the Atlas Search product team to close the feedback loop and further enhance the product moving forward. This includes both lexical and semantic search offerings.

This role will be based remotely in Barcelona, Dublin & London.

### **As an ideal candidate, you will have**

* 3+ years of search expertise (Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, Algolia, Lucidworks, or similar)
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 3+ years of pre-sales experience with enterprise software
* Solid understanding and ability to code with two or more modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, etc) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C, C++, C#, Java, etc)
* Experience with scalable and highly available distributed systems
* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time

### **You may also have**

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* A MongoDB Certification
* A major cloud provider certification

### **What you do at MongoDB**

* Design systems, applications, and infrastructure to help drive software development projects using MongoDB and the Atlas Developer Data Platform (DDP)
* Advise customers on architectures, patterns, and strategies for making the best use of MongoDB
* Expertly articulate the business value of MongoDB solutions
* Align to support sales with activities such as technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentation, sizing, and documentation of technical decision criteria; working across a number of opportunities in parallel
* Translate technical concepts and patterns into business benefits for management and executives
* Act as a liaison, collecting feedback from the field to relay back to the Product Management team
* Help drive demand through participation in both industry-known trade-shows as well account-based marketing events
* Demonstrate resilience and sound judgment in dealing with business challenges
* Proactively seek opportunities to support and mentor other pre-sales team members and share standard methodologies
* Help enable other solutions architects with knowledge on search technical and business concepts as well as build tools to allow other SAs to demonstrate these concepts
* Assist in the direction of Vector Search and AI/ML through taking customer needs and interactions to Product Management
* Embody MongoDB's core values in our interactions with internal teams and customers

### **What you will learn**

* The rapidly growing MongoDB product suite, including
* Core database server
* Atlas (fully managed cloud database service)
* The Atlas Developer Data Platform including Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, Atlas for the Edge, Realm, Charts, and Atlas Streams Processing
* Other Tools and connectors - Ops/Cloud Manager, Compass, Connector for BI, Connector for Spark
* Market-relevant, complementary technologies e.g. Apache Kafka, Kubernetes
* Modern and popular architecture design patterns, methodologies and concerns e.g. microservices, DevOps, cloud, security

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
