Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.
  
  
Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group.

### **Your Tasks**

* Design, implement, and maintain reliable automated test suites for web applications, mobile app and microservices aligned with business requirements.
* Collaborate actively within a multidisciplinary, international Squad (Developers, DevOps, UX/UI, Tech Lead, Product Owner, Product Manager) towards continuous delivery and high quality.
* Take ownership of testing strategy within the squad, managing test preparation, execution, and reporting from feature conception to production deployment.
* Perform end-to-end API testing (RESTful services), ensuring functional accuracy, performance, and data integrity.
* Implement and execute BDD (Behavior-Driven Development)
* Build and maintain web and app automation scripts using modern tools like Playwright and Selenium.
* Champion quality assurance best practices and integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with developers to ensure fast and efficient resolution.

### **Your Profile**

* 3+ years of experience working as a Quality Assurance / Test Automation Engineer.
* A native team player capable of working effectively within small, heterogeneous, and agile international teams.
* Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to communicate effectively within an international team and collaborate across different stakeholders.
* Outstanding QA Soft Skills: Strong critical thinking, meticulous attention to detail, constructive communication, and empathy when delivering feedback or documenting defects to foster a collaborative culture with developers.
* Solid hands-on experience in API Testing (REST APIs) using tools like Postman, Bruno, or code-based libraries (Requests, RestAssured, Robot Framework).
* Proven expertise in Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Behave (or similar Gherkin-based frameworks like Cucumber/SpecFlow).
* Strong practical experience in Web UI Automation using Playwright and/or Selenium.
* Good skills in a programming language suitable for automation test frameworks (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#).
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests into deployment flows.
* A proactive and growth-oriented mindset-an eager learner, passionate about continuously advancing their QA skills, exploring new testing tools, and staying up-to-date with quality practices.
* Deep understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, bug life cycle management, and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
* A hands-on mindset-you take ownership of quality and test execution from planning to release

Permanent

**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

**The role**

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic professional who will be a key and influential member of our Hiscox London Market Engineering Team, within the Software Engineering Chapter. In this role you will be working in one of our various squads as we create new “Cloud First” solutions to add value to the business, while supporting and transforming our existing on-prem and cloud systems. We are looking for someone who is aligned with modern software engineering practices and ready to embrace the use of AI enabled development tool and adapt to the ever changing space as we enter the agentic SDLC phase to allow rapid delivery of high quality value.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Work collaboratively with your squad and stakeholders to contribute to delivering business outcomes
* Write clean, maintainable code following best practices such as SOLID principles, design patterns, unit testing, peer review, and CI/CD processes
* Ensure documentation are up to date and detailed comments added to the stories
* Support team members by learning from others and sharing knowledge as you grow in your role
* Assist in designing solutions and implementing changes based on requirements
* Collaborate with engineers across teams to learn about and contribute to our architecture
* Ensure your work follows security and engineering standards with support from the team
* Be open to learning and adopting new ways of working, including AI-assisted development tools and ever changing space as we enter agentic SDLC phase
* Work collaboratively with team members located in the United Kingdom, Portugal, Poland, and India to deliver value

**Skills**:

* Academic degree in a closely related field (or 3+ years employment in a Software Engineering role)
* Candidates should have a strong foundation and hands-on experience in C# and .NET, with the ability to write and maintain effective unit tests.
* Should have a solid background in SQL and be comfortable working with relational databases
* Should have knowledge on CI/CD pipelines and a good understanding of source control systems and branching strategies
* Exposure to Azure technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, and Azure API Management (APIM) would be considered an advantage
* Knowledge on Azure Service Bus would be advantageous, particularly in event-driven or messaging-based architectures.
* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies such as Blazor/Angular/React would be beneficial for building responsive and user-friendly applications.

### **Behaviours**

* Demonstrates enthusiasm for learning new technologies, tools, and ways of working, actively seeking opportunities to grow technical and professional skills.
* Takes ownership of assigned tasks and delivers work to agreed standards with appropriate support and guidance.
* Communicates clearly and respectfully with colleagues, asking thoughtful questions and sharing progress proactively.
* Collaborates effectively with teammates and contributes positively to an inclusive and supportive team environment.
* Shows curiosity about the business, customers, and products, seeking to understand how their work contributes to business outcomes.
* Follows established engineering standards, development practices, and security requirements, while building a strong foundation in software engineering principles.
* Approaches challenges with a positive mindset, demonstrating resilience and a willingness to learn from mistakes and feedback.
* Adapts to changing priorities and embraces new ways of working in a fast-paced environment.
* Seeks and acts upon feedback to continuously improve technical skills, effectiveness, and professional development.
* Demonstrates attention to detail and a commitment to producing reliable, well-tested, and maintainable solutions.
* Contributes ideas and suggestions for improving processes, team practices, and customer outcomes.
* Builds positive working relationships through professionalism, respect, empathy, and a willingness to support others.
* Takes responsibility for personal learning and development and actively participates in knowledge-sharing opportunities.
* Demonstrates a growth mindset, showing initiative and motivation to broaden technical expertise and industry knowledge.

At Hiscox we care about our people. We hire the best people for the job and we’re committed to diversity and creating a truly inclusive culture, which we believe drives success.

We have also learned over the past couple of years that working life doesn’t always have to be in the office, and have adopted hybrid ways of working to encourage a healthy work life balance.

We see it as the best of both worlds: structure and sociability on one hand, and independence and flexibility on the other.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives.

Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.  
Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Risk Management Engineer or Project Controls Engineer with risk management experience to join our organization in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating project risks while maintaining robust project controls across multiple initiatives. You will work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, and senior management to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex risk and control information effectively to diverse audiences.

* Acting as the Risk facilitator for a large aviation/ airport project.
* Implementing the Risk Management Plan and supporting project teams in applying the risk management process.
* Facilitating risk workshops with project stakeholders.
* Maintaining risk registers and ensuring risks and associated actions are updated accordingly.
* Preparing monthly and ad hoc risk reports.
* Undertaking ad hoc Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRAs), where required, outside of the formal Risk Management Plan and delivery governance framework.
* Maintaining a strong focus on risk mitigation plans and proactively following up with action owners to ensure timely completion of agreed actions.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 3 - 5+ years of experience in risk management, project controls, or related project management discipline
* Demonstrated expertise in risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning
* Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent)
* Experience developing and maintaining risk registers and control documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings to senior stakeholders
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and collaborate across multiple project teams
* Background in construction, engineering, or infrastructure project delivery or planning / project controls functions within a PMC/PMO environment is desired

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Microsoft Developer
new_jobs.description:
België
  
Gent, Westerlo, Zottegem
  
Voltijds
  
  
Als Full Stack Microsoft Developer werk je aan het bouwen en uitbreiden van oplossingen binnen Dynamics 365 en het Power Platform.
  
  
Je vertaalt complexe klantvragen naar stabiele en performante toepassingen. Dat doe je met .NET en moderne Microsoft-technologieën zoals Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI en Azure Services. Je werkt aan oplossingen die niet alleen technisch sterk zijn, maar ook echt gebruikt worden in de praktijk.
  
  
Jouw DNA ontmoet ons DNA
  
  
Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, menselijk en technologisch. We verbinden mensen, data en technologie om samen slimmer te werken en verder te kijken. We zijn nieuwsgierige doeners die niet bang zijn om te ontdekken, te proberen en te groeien. Want leren doe je door te doen en fouten horen daar gewoon bij. Onze blik? Gericht op de toekomst. Ons hart? Dicht bij elkaar. We dromen groot, maar blijven met beide voeten op de grond. Hier krijg je de ruimte om jezelf uit te dagen, initiatief te nemen en mee te bouwen aan iets dat beweegt. Brave yourself for progress, samen maken we groei echt menselijk.
  
  
Je komt terecht in de Customer Engagement unit binnen onze Public Business Line. Een team van 18 technische consultants die zich volledig toeleggen op Dynamics 365 en het Power Platform. Samen met functionele collega’s, projectmanagers en (pre)sales specialisten werk je aan oplossingen die publieke organisaties digitaal vooruithelpen.
  
  
Van uitdaging naar oplossing
  
  
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen Dynamics 365 en het Power Platform
  
  
Je bouwt uitbreidingen op bestaande functionaliteiten in .NET
  
  
Je werkt aan zowel backendlogica als gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces
  
  
Je werkt nauw samen met functionele analisten en collega-developers
  
  
Je test je werk, documenteert duidelijk en bewaakt de kwaliteit van je code
  
  
Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen, nieuwe features en optimalisaties
  
  
Je werkt in Agile teams via Azure DevOps aan projecten (vaak langlopend en in de publieke sector)
  
  
Wat jij kan, maakt het verschil
  
  
Investeren in jou, investeren in groei
  
  
Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, ook voor jou. We willen dat je groeit, je goed voelt en trots bent op wat je doet. Daarom zorgen we voor voordelen die echt iets betekenen:
  
  
Over ons
  
Wij zijn een full-service technology partner in progress – even naar adem happen – die klaar is om onze sector wakker te schudden. Hoe? Door onszelf te verwonderen. Door nieuwsgierig te blijven, creatieve oplossingen te bedenken, en door vooral nooit te stoppen met vragen te stellen – zoals: “Wat als ik meer wil weten over deze vacature?” Wel, dan vertellen wij alles wat je wil weten.
